properties.title: DUMBO historic street restoration and Pearl Street Plaza completed
properties.short_description: NYC DDC, DOT, and DEP recorded completion of a 108 million USD DUMBO historic restoration and infrastructure project on 19 November 2025.

properties.title: East Flatbush and Canarsie green infrastructure was announced complete

properties.title: East River Park phase 2 amenities reopened

properties.explanation: Multiple reconstructed park amenities entered documented public use, including tennis courts, multiuse turf, basketball courts, picnic and BBQ areas, lawn, nature exploration, and water play.
